intent: Preserve ACTIVE_TRACK's declared pull-request versus scheduled freshness policy with an exclusive typed freshness modality: only elapsed-time drift whose criterion and evidence artifact are proven unchanged by the reviewed diff may warn on normal pull-request evaluation; PR-caused stale regressions, every executed stale criterion under --enforce-ttl, compound stale-and-low mutation scores, non-finite scores or thresholds, corruption, malformed evidence, and other executed regressions stay fail-closed.

gates.name: active-track-freshness-touched-file-ruff
gates.command: python3 -m ruff check scripts/governance/check_track_status.py tests/test_active_track_governance.py tests/test_claim_evidence_binding.py

commit.message: fix(governance): bind freshness authority to reviewed diff

interface_mismatches: CriterionResult records one typed failure modality, while mutation-score evaluation can observe compound elapsed-freshness and below-threshold failures. The modality must be treated as an exclusive cause so freshness cannot erase the substantive safety regression.

The previous pull-request severity split trusted the FRESHNESS modality without proving that the reviewed diff left the criterion and evidence artifact unchanged, so a PR-authored stale receipt could be downgraded.

The scheduled --enforce-ttl path previously consulted only the prior-pass regression set, so warn-only publication could remove a still-stale criterion from that set and make the next scheduled run false-green.
Mutation-score validation rejected non-finite observed scores but not non-finite configured thresholds, allowing stale evidence to be misclassified as freshness-only.
honest_blockers: The freshness modality is exclusive rather than additive: it is emitted only when elapsed age is the sole observed failure. Compound stale-and-low scores carry both facts in detail and remain blocking.

The ordinary pull-request downgrade is allowed only when a base-ref comparison proves both the completion criterion and its repository evidence artifact unchanged; a changed or uninspectable input remains blocking.
The scheduled --enforce-ttl authority blocks every executed FRESHNESS failure even when the latest derived baseline already records that criterion as failed.
Missing, malformed, tampered, below-threshold, non-finite-score, and non-finite-threshold evidence remains fail-closed on both normal and --enforce-ttl paths.
The branch remains subject to the Phase 0 M0 merge boundary and one post-M0 rebase; this packet does not authorize merging or rewrite any merged closure packet.
Exact-head hosted CI, a fresh exact-head Codex review, and human merge authority remain required.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the checker, focused tests, and this current unmerged packet together. Reverting restores the known false blocker for freshness-only drift and the known downgrade bug for compound stale-and-low mutation evidence.
